analysis.rationale: 3-step deterministic pipeline. JPEG: block_boundary=5.177 (0%FP) -> compression_jpeg:4 (signal severity curve 61%/15%/40% for sev5/4/3). Blur: DT glass (glass_score=1.58, gm_ratio=0.33, anisotropy=1.23 not motion); signal verify matched blur:spectral_slope + blur:wiener_kernel; glass:5 > gaussian:5 by 0.32 dB. Global: variance_ratio=0.589 -> contrast_weaken_scale:1 (+1.86 dB vs no-global; sev2/3 worse; stretch/brightness variants rejected by mean_shift/variance signal checks). Order blur->jpeg->contrast (block_boundary 15% vs 21% for contrast-first). Noise: NO_NOISE (sigma 0.74 target / 1.73 peeled << 2; peeled residual structured spatial_corr=0.96). PSNR<30 because glass blur is stochastic (pixel-shuffle random seed, SKILL C4: never >40 dB), and residual signal diffs (block_boundary 15%, variance_ratio 27%, mean_shift 0.031) are minor; verdict UNCERTAIN per exp37 PSNR rules.
